newsitem.title: USA: JLG Industries expects record FY97.
newsitem.headline: JLG Industries expects record FY97.

text.p: JLG Industries Inc said on Monday it expected to have a record year in fiscal 1997, and that its order backlog was strong.

The company, which makes, distributes and markets aerial work platforms, said it was optimistic for 1997 due to continued growth in most of the world economies, strong backlog and incoming order levels and an expanding worldwide sales base.
New products brought to the market in the second half of fiscal 1996 should continue to contribute to sales, the company also said.
Customers were experiencing high utilization rates for their equipment, and were ordering more machines, JLG said.

"Net income gains are expected to continue outpacing revenue growth due to our onging emphasis on improving manufacturing efficiencies and cutting costs," the company said. It also said its balance sheet remained strong, with minimum debt and healthy cash reserves.
In the first quarter 1997, JLG reported earnings of $0.28 per share versus $0.18 per share in the same period last year.
